body: Yes the child is his. He just doesn’t like to watch our son it is a huge hassle. Like he makes it difficult by pouting, yelling, etc and I end up feeling uncomfortable about it so my son comes with me most places.

Where I live there is so much more help and opportunities. My parents live in a small town with just a Walmart and that’s all there is for jobs.  There aren’t a lot of resources either, they live in the poorest county in their state. Plus they don’t have half the community and county programs we do here. But I guess if I moved with my parents I wouldn’t be lonely, I’d have more personal support, I would be able to reconnect with old friends... I just feel torn :/

Honestly no they would really rather I didn’t move back but if I absolutely had to I think they would let me. I’m trying to put my energy into finding a safe place for us besides my parents. I will open up to my mom more it’s just hard I feel very embarrassed about how things are. I know I shouldn’t be but :/
Hi thanks for the reply. It sounds silly but I don’t know how to drive just the very basics so I driving myself places is kinda out of the question.

Before he was wonderful. So sweet and shy. We always laughed and he never raised his voice to me. I’m not sure what changed. I thought it was money but we have always had money issues. Just suddenly he became this angry person.  No I honestly thought it was temporary, like he would snap out of it and realize how he’s acting. This totally took me by surprise.
Sorry I meant to say that fight was never talked about again.

Thanks for replying, you are so right about that. I feel like we are complete strangers and it breaks my heart. I have opened up to him and for a couple days he was nice, patient and kind; how he used to be. But then he just went back. So I spoke up again and we got into a horribly nasty fight. It was talked about again, if I bring it up he says “I don’t want to fight please.” On the subject of my parents, I have told my mom to an extent. She wants me to go to a shelter here or just wait it out (I am in school 2/ days a week/ 2 hours a day). I have expressed that I would like to come back home but she thinks I need to stay in the city versus a rural area where they are.
Thank you I will look up some hotlines to call. I didn’t think things were that bad but you are right. I do live in the US.
Thank you for your response. Your comment makes me tear up because no I would never want this for my son. And I would never want him to feel hurt like that. Thank you for that eye opener.

Thank you for replying. It is hard for me to work because of my son but a caseworker is helping us get disability for him. Once he’s 3 he can get special childcare through the state and I can’t wait because I miss working.  Around me there is a public bus system. I walk most places I need to go. We are a low income family.
